Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Transient stimulus then washout: ATAC-seq/CUT&RUN persistence
ideas.description: Expose cells to a transient AP-1 activating stimulus (e.g., TPA, injury, or cytokine), then wash out and profile chromatin accessibility and AP-1 (FOS/JUN) binding at days to weeks. Persistent open sites that remain after AP-1 itself returns to baseline would indicate memory, like the 'hoseless' or 'unreleased' state that stays set after the trigger is gone.

ideas.title: Acute degron depletion to separate maintenance from initiation
ideas.description: Use an auxin-inducible degron or dTAG on JUN/FOS at defined times (before, during, or after the priming stimulus) and measure whether accessibility and re-stimulation response are lost. If depleting AP-1 after priming does not erase the memory, it is needed only to write it. If depletion erases it, AP-1 is also needed to maintain it.

ideas.title: Re-stimulation kinetics and dose-response of primed vs naive cells
ideas.description: Prime cells with a first stimulus, rest them, then give a second challenge. Use time-resolved RNA-seq or nascent transcription (PRO-seq) to compare induction speed and magnitude with naive cells, and test whether this depends on AP-1 motif-bearing enhancers. Compare with enhancer-motif mutants or dCas9 blocking of selected sites to show causality.

ideas.title: Single-cell multiome lineage tracing of memory inheritance
ideas.description: Combine single-cell RNA and ATAC with live reporters of AP-1 activity, and track cells across divisions by barcodes or time-lapse imaging. Test whether primed accessibility and responsiveness pass from mother to daughter cells and whether they decay in a heritable, cell-autonomous way rather than reflecting continuing signaling.

ideas.title: Synthetic AP-1 activation and epigenetic mark readout
ideas.description: Use optogenetic or chemogenetic control of FOS/JUN, or a dCas9-AP-1 tether, to impose AP-1 activity at a chosen locus, then remove it. Measure H3K27ac, H3K4me1 and DNA methylation, and whether the locus stays open without AP-1 by a feed-forward loop, sufficiency being the strongest test of memory.
